name: SimpleStamp Designer
author: simplestampdesigner

sections.description:
SimpleStamp Designer turns any WooCommerce product into a fully customizable stamp. Customers type their text directly on the product page, see an accurate live preview instantly, and add the finished stamp design to the cart — ready for laser engraving.

Features in the free version

  • Text editor for rectangular stamps (bold, italic, underline, alignment, borders)
  • Curved-text editor for round stamps (Model 1: full outer ring, Model 3: arc top + bottom)
  • Upload a custom graphic (SVG, PNG, JPG, PDF)
  • Unlimited stamp profiles (sizes/shapes), including JSON import/export; 5 ready-made profiles included to get started
  • Automatic, millimeter-precise SVG export for laser engraving software
  • Direct WooCommerce cart integration, including “Edit design” from the cart

With [SimpleStamp Pro Designer](https://simplestamp-designer.de)

  • Over 80 ready-made profiles for common stamp models (free version includes 5)
  • Upload your own fonts or choose from Google Fonts
  • Add a logo alongside the text, freely movable and resizable
  • Additional curved-text models (2 and 4)

Note: This plugin requires WooCommerce and will not work without it.

Note on oval stamps: Oval stamp shapes are not yet included in this version and are planned for an upcoming update.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is already installed and active.
  2. Upload and activate the plugin via “Plugins” → “Add New”.
  3. Under “Stamp Designer” → “Import / Export”, import the bundled default profiles (or create your own).
  4. For each WooCommerce product that should be sold as a stamp, open it for editing and assign the matching stamp profile under “General”.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin work without WooCommerce?

No. SimpleStamp Designer is built entirely on top of WooCommerce (products, cart, orders) and cannot be activated without it.

How many stamp profiles can I create in the free version?

As many as you like. The free version ships with 5 ready-made profiles to get started; SimpleStamp Pro Designer, a separate product, ships with more than 80 ready-made profiles.

Are oval stamps supported?

Not yet — this is planned for an upcoming update.

How do I export the finished design for my laser engraving software?

Every order automatically includes a ready-made SVG (registration marks and cut line provided separately), downloadable from the order details in the WordPress admin area.
sections.changelog:
2.19.4

  • Security: added nonce verification to the add-to-cart design form (custom stamp fields and the “replace existing cart item” logic were previously accepted from $_POST without a nonce check)

2.19.3

  • Added a one-time cleanup tool (Stamp Designer → Import / Export) that detects duplicate profiles/categories left over from earlier installations, shows a preview, and merges them only after explicit confirmation (profiles are moved to trash, not permanently deleted)

2.19.2

  • Fix: the “Import default profiles” button (and the custom JSON import) could create duplicate profiles if run more than once, since removing the 2.19.1 profile-limit code also removed a side effect that had accidentally prevented this; importing now skips any profile whose title already exists

2.19.1

  • Removed the technical 5-profile limit; the free version now allows unlimited stamp profiles (5 ready-made profiles remain included, Pro’s larger library of 80+ remains a Pro feature)
  • Removed remaining unreachable Pro-only code paths (logo overlay, curved-text models 2/4); the free version now only shows an informational locked badge for these, with no Pro functionality shipped
  • The plugin no longer deactivates another, separately installed plugin automatically; it now shows a notice with a link the site admin has to click themselves
  • Renamed all internal identifiers (post type, taxonomy, option and meta-data keys) from the 3-character prefix “ssd_” to the required 4-character “ssdx_”; existing data is migrated automatically on first load after the update

2.19.0

  • Renamed to SimpleStamp Designer
  • Removed the font-management and logo-overlay code entirely from this free version (previously present but always locked); these remain exclusive to the separate SimpleStamp Pro Designer product
  • Removed the license-checking system from this free version (it never applied here, since this version is permanently free)
  • Security: uploaded SVG files are now sanitized (scripts, event-handler attributes, and embedded foreign content are stripped) before being stored
  • Moved inline admin styles/scripts into properly enqueued files
  • readme.txt rewritten in English per WordPress.org policy

2.18.9

  • Fix: replaced the default “Add to cart” button with a “Design now” button on the shop and category pages for stamp products, so customers can no longer add an undesigned stamp straight to the cart from a product listing

2.18.5

  • Replaced placeholder profile preview images with final product photos
  • Updated plugin URI and website links

2.17.4

  • Fix: WooCommerce dependency is now detected reliably, regardless of plugin activation order
  • Fix: clear notice for shop owners when a product has no stamp profile assigned yet
  • Oval stamp shape temporarily removed (rendering issues with borders and curved text)
  • Improved distinction between preview and input field in the designer

2.17.0

  • First Free/Pro version: 5-profile limit, showcase preview of additional profiles, locked Pro features shown with a note
